origin: allows non-forbidden functions from the same module
source:
defmodule MyModule do
  def safe do
    SomeModule.safe_function(foo)
  end
end

defmodule MyModule do
  def my_function do
    :erlang.term_to_binary(%{foo: "bar"})
  end
end

origin: it should report on different arities
source:
defmodule MyModule do
  def dangerous do
    SomeModule.dangerous_function()
    SomeModule.dangerous_function("foo")
    SomeModule.dangerous_function("foo", "bar")
  end
end
